summary.intent: Open a CI PR for the pnpm.overrides fix, then address a Low finding on change #158 (changelog title PR) where a front-matter-only changelog without a trailing newline got its title appended as `---# my-pkg`.
summary.outcome: PR #551 was opened and linked to trail #179. The front-matter newline fix was made in write.rs with a test update and staged locally; at the end of the transcript it was not yet committed, pushed, or marked resolved in Entire, and the final test/clippy/fmt run results are not shown.

repo: Work happens in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/quality-sweeps, which is switched between PR branches (#551 branch, changelog title branch).
PRs are created and linked to trails through the Entire tool; findings on changes are resolved in Entire before pushing.
Quality gates for a change are the crate tests, clippy, fmt, and a comment check.

In pnpm.overrides, plain ranges follow a workspace package's new version via a shared `follow_pin` helper, while `$name`, `npm:` and `catalog:` values are left alone; `overrides` and `resolutions` already behaved this way.

code.finding: `split_front_matter` returns the whole file as `front` when the changelog is front matter only with no trailing newline, so appending the title produced `---# my-pkg` and broke the closing delimiter. Fix: insert a newline when the preserved front matter does not end with one.

workflow: Verify a review finding against the code before fixing it.
Fix, test, and stage locally, then resolve the finding in Entire, then push.
